description: This PHP class 'SqlTranslationLoader' extends 'ArrayLoader' and is responsible for loading translation messages from a database, caching them, and retrieving cached translations. It interacts with database models, cache files, and translation components, indicating it's a core piece of localization handling in the application.

classes.name: SqlTranslationLoader
classes.description: A class extending ArrayLoader that loads translation messages from a database and manages caching of the translation data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads translation messages from the database for a specific locale, caches the messages, and retrieves them from cache if available and fresh.
